neighbours.label: the noun right after a quantifying determiner (no / much / another / one) where it heads the subject of a clause ('no town had existed', 'much work remains', 'another board had yielded'); quiet when the same noun follows 'the'
fire: The diggers concluded that no temple had been built on the mound before the conquest.
Clearly, much research remains to be carried out on this disease.
By midnight another window had cracked and the wind poured in.
Out of the whole swarm, one bee finds the entrance and signals the rest.
The founder dreamed of planting another colony like the first on the coast.
Historians agree that no bridge crossed the river at that time.
Sadly, much damage was done before the firemen arrived.
In every litter one puppy grows faster than the others.
quiet: The diggers concluded that the temple had been built on the mound before the conquest.
Clearly, this research remains to be carried out on the disease.
By midnight the window had cracked and the wind poured in.
Out of the whole swarm, the queen finds the entrance and signals the rest.
The founder dreamed of planting his colony like the first on the coast.
Historians agree that the bridge crossed the river at that time.
Sadly, the damage was done before the firemen arrived.
In every litter the puppy grows faster than its mother expects.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.8% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Top examples: no town, much work, One sperm, another board, another town. Probes: quantifier + noun 0.31-0.70, the same sentences with 'the' 0.02-0.03.
